About the website

This website introduces Fusion Labs, a studio within Neurofusion Systems in Harare, Zimbabwe. Contact info@fusionlabs.co.zw with questions about its content or services.

Information and prices

Prices displayed on the services page are our service prices in USD, using the billing unit shown. Design and development are separate services unless combined in your proposal. Equipment, domains and third-party licences are charged separately. Digital marketing and website management are quoted individually.

Enquiries and project agreements

Sending an enquiry or downloading a brief does not book a service or make a payment. Deliverables, revisions, timing, payment arrangements, ownership and ongoing support are set out in the proposal agreed for your project. See our service policy for the details to review before work begins.

Responsible use

Use the website and enquiry channels for legitimate enquiries. Do not attempt to disrupt the website, gain unauthorised access, or submit material that you do not have permission to share.

Content and external links

Contact us before reusing Fusion Labs branding or website content. Photographs and fonts may carry separate licences; photo credits link to their sources. External websites operate independently and have their own terms and privacy practices.

Availability and corrections

If a link fails, a download does not work or information appears incorrect, email us with the page and issue. You can email your enquiry directly if the form cannot open your email app.

Privacy

Our privacy and cookies notice explains the current form, downloaded briefs and external services. These website terms do not replace the agreement for a commissioned project.
